title: Verify a frontend through the real harness process
statement: As a developer building a frontend around an AI harness, I can test writing input and rendering output through the real harness process so that I verify the frontend integration and the exercised binary behavior on the underlying OS.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The frontend under test can write input to the real harness process configured for the mock provider.
After the test prescribes a provider response, it can assert on the frontend rendering of output produced by the real harness process.
